item.title: Iconic Coney Island hot dog hawker Nathan's Famous is sold for $450 million
item.description: Nathan’s Famous, which opened as a 5-cent hot dog stand in Coney Island more than a century ago, has been sold to packaged meat giant Smithfield Foods.

item.title: Woman who led ICE protest at Minnesota church service has been arrested, Bondi says
item.description: Attorney General Pam Bondi says a woman who led an anti-immigration enforcement protest that disrupted a service at a Minnesota church has been arrested.

item.title: Wild West booze: 150-year-old bottle unearthed in historic Utah mining town
item.description: An archaeological team in Utah has discovered a literal time capsule from the state's Wild West past: a bottle of alcohol that had been buried for over a century.

item.title: Finding the sweet spot: HVAC experts reveal optimal winter thermostat settings to save money
item.description: HVAC experts recommend 67-70 degree thermostat settings for winter savings. Learn maintenance tips and insulation strategies to reduce heating bills.

item.title: More than 10,000 flights canceled as massive winter storm sweeps across US
item.description: A massive winter storm set the stage for a brutal travel day Sunday, with airlines warning of widespread cancellations and delays at some of the nation's busiest airports.

item.title: Saving your credit card means a faster checkout, but is it worth the risk?
item.description: Many online retailers suggest you store your credit card on their site to make future purchases quicker. But one man learned a big downside of doing so.

item.title: What to know about bigger refunds and this year's deadlines as tax season begins
item.description: The filing window for 2025 federal tax returns opened on Monday January 26, starting a day earlier than last year and extending through the deadline of April 15, 2026.

item.title: Southwest Airlines converts to assigned seating for all flights
item.description: Southwest Airlines implemented assigned seating on Tuesday, marking one of the biggest changes for the low-cost airline's ticketing and boarding practices since the business was founded.

item.title: Thousands of McCafé K-Cups recalled over labeling error
item.description: More than 80,000 K-Cup pods have been recalled because of a labeling error that could lead to someone consuming more caffeine than they anticipated.

item.title: Investigators say deadly midair collision near DC followed years of ignored warnings about traffic
item.description: NTSB board members were deeply troubled Tuesday over years of ignored warnings before last year's midair collision between an American Airlines jet and an Army Black Hawk, which killed 67 people.
